BEAMNG LIVERY DESIGNER
======================
1. Double-click LiveryDesigner.html. It opens in your web browser (Chrome,
   Edge or Firefox) and runs on your computer. No internet needed and
   nothing to install.
2. Click "Guide: how to make and install" at the top of the app, or open
   GUIDE.html, for step-by-step instructions:
     - finding the vehicle's files (stock or modded)
     - loading the vehicle's UV template and materials file
     - marking the left and right sides
     - adding and editing text, shapes, stripes, paint and logos
     - exporting, then pasting the livery inside the vehicle's mod file
       (or dropping it in your mods folder)
     - picking it in the game: Vehicle Config > Parts > Paint Design

Keep your project file (.livery.json, from "Save project") so you can
change the livery later.
